title: F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026: Celebrity Sightings, the Biggest Parties and Where to Watch, Stay, Shop and Dine (Updating)
summary: From Wynn’s Charles Leclerc cafe and Lewis Hamilton’s new pop-up to a Jay-Z-hosted celebration and the Backstreet Boys at Sphere, the world’s flashiest street race electrifies with major moments — plus last-minute deals on tickets, hotels and more.
